scope.description: One exact Agile Electromagnetics refresh covering corporate identity, product separation, engineering context, government evaluation, funding, prototype integration and bounded decision questions.

source.title: Agile Electromagnetics current homepage
source.locator: Hero, product catalogue, services and footer
source.summary: The current homepage describes Agile Electromagnetics as a Canadian electronic-warfare and remote-sensing company and names its current product and engineering-service families.

leads.evidenceLocator: Corporations Canada, Agile product and service pages, CanadaBuys, ISED, National Defence, Open Government contribution records and Ottawa Business Journal
followUpQuestions: Which Hydra configuration was contracted and selected for testing, and what range, accuracy, latency, environmental and acceptance results can be shared?
Which NATO protocols, STANAGs, command-and-control interfaces, host-platform dependencies and cybersecurity controls are implemented and independently verified?
Which Hydra, Artemis and EMSO configurations are orderable now, at what production rate and lead time, with which support, export and controlled-goods requirements?
What prototype, test result, platform integration and follow-on path emerged from the UAV polarimetric ground-penetrating-radar project after May 30, 2026?
reviewWarnings: C2EWS, Hydra Cognitive Electronic Warfare System and Hydra Multi-Function Antenna System remain separate public labels because reviewed sources do not establish an identity or product-evolution chain.
The 2025 C2EWS Sandbox was detection-only, and no Agile-specific range, accuracy, latency, classification, reliability or other performance result is public.
The Hydra Testing Stream contract and 2026 Sandbox listing establish funded evaluation and selection, not completed testing, operational adoption, deployment or endorsement.
Agile's reference to NATO protocols does not name a STANAG, API, command-and-control interface, cybersecurity control or independent interoperability acceptance.
Public sources do not disclose orderable configurations, production capacity, delivery schedules, pricing, certifications, export terms or definitive Controlled Goods status.
The UAV polarimetric-radar agreement ended May 30, 2026, but no completion result, exact readiness level, test performance, host platform, integrator or field deployment is public.
The MIL-V evidence concerns a prototype contribution and does not name Hydra or Artemis or establish a Canadian Armed Forces vehicle contract.
Artemis remains supported only by company product material; no third-party test, integrator, customer, deployment or measured performance source was found.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed Agile Electromagnetics' current Canadian identity, four-product catalogue, engineering-service families and public contact pathway.
Resolved Hydra, Artemis, multi-function EMSO and command-software descriptions but found no product PDF, benchmark, qualification report or interface specification.
Confirmed active federal corporation 1316402-1, 2021-07-07 incorporation, Kanata registered office and the bounded more-than-75-percent significant-control record.
Exact company, applicant, assignee and product-title searches across CIPO, WIPO and Google Patents produced zero confidently attributable public Agile patent records.
Confirmed the 2026-06-18 CAD 2,621,146.87 Hydra Testing Stream R&D contract and kept unnamed historical DND contracts separate from current products.
Resolved separate C2EWS funding stages, the 2025 detection-only demonstration, 2026 Hydra selection and the distinct UAV polarimetric-radar contribution.
Confirmed Agile's reported counter-drone contribution to the MIL-V prototype while finding no named Agile product, technical result or Canadian Armed Forces vehicle contract.
Confirmed current CADSI membership and AOC founder recognition but found no independent capability benchmark, certification, delivery or customer validation.
Confirmed the French Hydra Testing Stream listing and DND Sandbox terminology; the bilingual pass added no distinct material claim beyond the English government records.
Final certification, Controlled Goods, allied-government, customer, deployment and current-product sweeps produced zero new qualifying proof beyond the Canadian evaluation records.

leads.refreshSummary: Agile Electromagnetics is proposed to update current activity to the 2026-06-18 Hydra R&D contract, update operating context to its RF, FPGA/RFSoC and edge-machine-learning stack, separate Hydra from C2EWS, Artemis and EMSO, and add UAV-radar, program, funding and MIL-V records.
intendedChanges: Set ownership and corporate context from active federal corporation 1316402-1, its 2021-07-07 incorporation and the bounded significant-control record.
Update description, commercial_status, defence_posture, public_contact, operating_context, canadian_footprint, executive_relevance_summary, reviewed_questions and portfolioScope.
Set current_activity and current_activity_as_of to the 2026-06-18 Hydra Testing Stream R&D contract.
Update the existing aggregate capability to Hydra and add separate C2EWS, Artemis, multi-function EMSO, EMSO command software, engineering-services and UAV-radar capabilities.
Add C2EWS development, Hydra Testing Stream and 2025 or 2026 Sandbox program participations.
Add three bounded IDEaS funding events without treating award ceilings as revenue or procurement adoption.
Add the Convergence Design Services MIL-V prototype relationship without naming an unsupported product or customer adoption.
